title: An exact 3^h restoration optimum for a decision on 4^h unknown-source leaves
statement: Let g(x)=1{2*x1+x2+x3+x4>=3}. The eight monochromatic subcubes *000,*111,01*0,10*1,001*,110*,0*01,1*10 partition its inputs and each fixes three coordinates. Recursing through their three fixed children on a height-h four-branch decision tree selects exactly 3^h leaves out of N=4^h. Refreshing those leaves restores the entire product law conditional on the decision and disclosed certificate. The function has sensitivity 3^h, so the unrestricted worst-source expected additional unit-call minimax optimum equals 3^h. Acquisition and persistent storage cost O(4^h); retained summaries allow O(3^h) update work. Repeated released decisions have the law of independent fresh-product decisions, but whole cache versions remain correlated. Producer fair four-bit checks report P(H1=a,H2=b)=1/4 while P(Y=X)=1/8, versus 1/16 for independent whole caches. This is a structural mathematical witness, with the same partition available to ordinary resampling, not a scientific-workload advantage.

Known decision channel A(h|x); nonnegative functions d_{h,S}(x_S) summing to A; choose S retrospectively with probability d/A, then refresh S from independent charged source callbacks
Specified future record, including H, refresh addresses S and replaced old X_S when these are disclosed; no freely retained unaccounted complete old-cache record
Sequential bound: finite alphabets, full support, correctness for both source families, almost-sure termination, finite expected charged calls and parameter-independent private randomness
Recursive example: complete height-h four-branch tree of the literal tie-broken majority, unknown independent Bernoulli leaves, unit source costs and retained internal summaries

assumptions: The accessible released record must be specified. Conditional freshness relative to that record is not independence from the entire old cache. Sources are independent unknown product-coordinate laws with charged independent callbacks and no extra uncharged parameter information. The one-pass converse requires an exposed subset chosen before replacement draws; it does not characterize hidden-mask or fresh-outcome-adaptive algorithms. General LP construction can be exponential. The producer reports exact finite checks, but no executable final package was acquired and no independent scientific review is supplied. Historical novelty, useful scientific workload and practical advantage remain unresolved. Earlier adaptivity/freshness counterexamples, stationary-average and passive-physical failures remain. The posterior comparator remains adverse: ordinary local proposal 2.5174 versus spatial transport 7.6259 in source-cost times asymptotic variance for the stated statistic. No physical reset or broad application follows.
costs: All initial samples, summary acquisition and storage are paid. Recursive family: O(4^h) initial acquisition/construction and persistent storage; exactly 3^h fresh leaf samples and O(3^h) summary-update work per restoration; a separate full materialized copy costs O(4^h)
General binary LP has |H|*3^n local-component variables before structure; decision enumeration and decomposition construction/evaluation are additional, potentially exponential costs

Adaptive update pays selected target-block samples plus unselected fixed-model repairs and decomposition costs; choose direct fresh sampling if cheaper. Whole-trace factorization does not grant per-node DAG independence

An ordinary resampler given the same paid cache, partition and source access can execute this construction. The exact minimax source-call theorem does not establish historical priority, a wall-clock speedup or useful scientific advantage
Producer-reported finite rational primal/dual and law checks, height-two enumeration and height-seven incremental counts are retained as reports; no scientific programs were run for this intake
